title: State Bank of India — ₹10.9L Cr Market Cap (#4 in India) & $1B MUFG Social Loan
summary: SBI raised $1 billion through 5-year social loan from Japan's MUFG, the first social loan raised by an Indian bank.

blocks.content: **Overview**: SBI raised $1 billion through 5-year social loan from Japan's MUFG, the first social loan raised by an Indian bank.

items: **SBI raises $1 billion from MUFG via 5-year social loan** (Page 18): SBI raised $1 billion through 5-year social loan from Japan's MUFG, the first social loan raised by an Indian bank.

**SBI overtakes TCS to become India's 4th Most Valuable Company** (Page 20): SBI market cap crossed ₹10.9 lakh crore, surpassing TCS (₹10.5L Cr) to rank 4th (Reliance > HDFC Bank > Bharti Airtel > SBI).

**SBI targets increasing green advances to 10% by 2030, launches CHAKRA** (Page 24): SBI aims for 7.5-10% green advances by 2030 and launched CHAKRA Centre of Excellence for renewable energy and green hydrogen.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Public Sector Banking Scale & Balance Sheet Expansion. SBI market cap surpasses TCS; India's 1st commercial bank social loan.
